intro: Buildings and programmes our aluminium went into, arranged by the year the work completed. Each album is a set of photographs from site and from the plant.

albums.title: Marina Central Tower
albums.note: Forty-two storeys on a river-facing site, which meant wind loads that pushed the unit size down and the seal detail up. Units were glazed and water-tested at Binh Duong and craned straight from the trailer.

photos.c: West elevation from the river walk
Typical unit before glazing, split mullion visible
Water test at 720 Pa in the facade hall
Sun louvre run on the south face
Stack joint before the transom cover goes on

albums.title: Riverhouse Apartments
albums.note: Cyclonic region, which set the sash weight and therefore the roller specification. Anodic black rather than powder because the balconies are within 200 metres of tidal water.

photos.c: Sliding 93 track before the sash goes in

albums.title: EV Battery Tray Programme
albums.scope: Battery enclosure trays, 74,000 units per year
albums.note: Multi-void 6082 extrusion, friction-stir welded and helium leak tested. Three die iterations before the sections held tolerance across a full billet, which is the part of an automotive programme nobody photographs.

photos.c: Tray frame after welding, before machining
Die correction on the second iteration
Packed trays on the export dock

albums.title: Opera Residences
albums.scope: Facade cassettes and window systems, 9,600 m²
albums.note: A conservation-area frontage where the planning condition was that the metalwork must not read as new. Sablé bronze scatters the light enough that the elevation settles into the street rather than announcing itself.

photos.c: Cassette on the rail carrier before fixing
Sablé bronze sample against the neighbouring stone
Reveal detail at a window head

albums.title: Solar Mounting Rail Supply
albums.note: Not architectural work and not difficult sections. What the customer bought was schedule reliability across a monsoon season and a mill certificate they could pass straight to their certifying body.

photos.c: Bundled and strapped for sea freight

albums.title: Wilhelmina Office Fit-out
albums.note: Demountable was the whole brief: the tenant expected to reconfigure twice within the lease. Both faces of the partition sit flush with the glass so a wall reads the same from either side after it moves.

photos.c: Partition head detail at the ceiling grid
Glazed door in a slim frame

albums.title: My Khe Beach Resort
albums.note: Forty metres from the surf line. Everything visible is either 25-micron marine anodised or wood-grain over a marine primer; the fixings behind are stainless throughout, which is the part that decides whether the job still looks like this in ten years.

photos.c: Salt spray test coupon at 4,000 hours
Sill drainage before the deck goes down

albums.title: Honeycomb Lift Car Programme
albums.note: The weight saved comes off the counterweight and then off the motor duty, which is the argument that sold the programme. Extending our press to 4 metres removed the joint that had been the objection.

albums.title: Chroy Changvar Mall
albums.note: Delivered overland in three days from Binh Duong, which is the whole reason the job came to us rather than to a Chinese supplier quoting a lower rate and a six-week sea leg.

albums.title: Alameda Adaptive Reuse
albums.scope: Replacement windows and infill cladding, 3,300 m²
albums.note: A 1926 warehouse where the openings were all slightly different and none of them square. Every unit was measured on site and made to that measurement, which is slower than a schedule of five types and the only thing that works on a building like this.

photos.c: Original opening before the new frame
Solid panel infill at a former loading bay
Interior, restored truss and new glazing
